description: Maya is adopting a rescue dog named Bailey who has medical and behavioral needs. Read the unstructured information in Bailey_Info_Raw.txt on the desktop and create a well-organized care plan document with: (1) Daily medication schedule as a table with calculated dosages for Bailey's 45lb weight, (2) Behavioral triggers and responses, (3) Exercise routine considering hip dysplasia, (4) Emergency contact information, (5) First week adjustment goals. The document should be clearly formatted with headings and immediately usable by caregivers.
